title: Globally Simple Heffter Arrays $H(n;k)$ with $k \equiv 1 \pmod{4}$
summary: Heffter arrays are combinatorial structures used to construct orthogonal cyclic cycle decompositions and biembeddings of complete graphs onto surfaces. A Heffter array $H(m,n;h,k)$ is an $m \times n$ partially filled array with distinct nonzero entries from $\mathbb{Z}_{2nk+1}$ such that each row contains $h$ filled cells, each column contains $k$ filled cells, the elements in the filled cells form a half-set of $\mathbb{Z}_{2nk+1}$, and every row and column sums to zero modulo $2nk+1$.
